entries.zh: 尽：竭尽全力、尽力；耗尽、穷尽
entries.en: great effort; to do one's utmost, to exhaust, use up

entries.notes: 西语头词 Conabir 疑为 concebir 之残误拼式，本条仅“胎”字之音义可靠

entries.zh: 投：投掷、投入；投奔、投靠；受孕投胎之“投”
entries.en: to throw, cast; to throw oneself into; to go to, take refuge; (with 胎) to enter the womb, conceive

entries.zh: 投胎：受孕成胎、入胎受生；转世投生
entries.en: to conceive; to enter the womb, be conceived; to reincarnate

entries.zh: 头动：点头、动首示意（表应允、让步）
entries.en: to move the head; to nod in assent or concession
a load, burden; to carry a load
entries.notes: 西语短语沿上条“动头（bayando la cabeza）”重复，与“担头”字义不合，疑系串行误系

entries.zh: 呾来呾去：说来说去，一言来一言去（互有应答驳难）
entries.en: to keep saying back and forth, bandy words (one grants, another denies)
entries.notes: “呾”“来”两字均带[疑]（或作咀/來），据 M 音 tâ/lāy 定为言语往来义

entries.zh: 品：品评、评定（货品）等级；评定价钱
entries.en: to grade, appraise; to settle or fix the price

entries.zh: 说合、合意成交：双方议定价钱
entries.en: to come to terms, agree on a price; mutual assent in bargaining
entries.notes: 第二音节 gî 未证实（音注标 ?），首字“甲”疑为“合”之讹（kah-ì 合意），义据西语 concertar el precio 推断

entries.zh: 讨：讨取、索要；此处配“合谋为恶”，谓谋求、图谋
entries.en: to demand, exact, beg; (here) to seek, scheme ill
entries.notes: R 对音 koû 与“讨”不叶，语义据西语短语 Concertar para mal 推断

entries.zh: 度：揣度、估量；此处配“合谋为恶”，谓计度、谋算
entries.en: to estimate, gauge, consider; (here) to calculate, scheme
entries.notes: R 对音 chū 与“度”不叶，与上条“讨”共承西语“合谋为恶”之语境

entries.zh: 齐整：整齐、齐备；收拾整齐
entries.en: orderly, neat; to put in order, arrange

entries.zh: 齐应：齐声应答、一同应和
entries.en: to answer in unison, respond in accord

entries.notes: M 作两读 pag it / po it，与单字“朴”不合，疑杂有残文

entries.zh: 揽：包揽、承揽〔原件污损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to take on, contract for, monopolize [uncertain, source damaged]
entries.notes: M 声调记号 T99（污损难辨），且对音 mau/mān 与“攬”（lám）不叶，字义难定
R 对音 nêm 与“谋”（bōu/móu）不叶，字义据汉字与 M 音定，西语短语配合较松

entries.zh: 绵：绵连、连绵（接连不断）；绵软
